title: Design System: SNCMT School & College Management

display.purpose: The page title, once per page, with the Signal Blue bar above it. 2rem from 640px in Bangla; 1.625rem / 1.75rem in English.

headline.purpose: Section and card headings, such as "Class 7, section A".

title.purpose: Button labels, panel titles, student names in tables.

body.purpose: Table cells, form text and descriptions; 1rem in Bangla.

label.purpose: Column headings and small field labels; uppercase in shared tables.

mono.purpose: Codes only, such as the school's subdomain.

hero-name.purpose: The school's name over the homepage photographs, white, two lines at most. The largest text anywhere.

chapter-numeral.purpose: A homepage chapter's number ("01", "০১") in Register Navy Ink, regular weight like a printed folio; 2.75rem on phones.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Only for things that float above the page: menus, dropdowns, popovers, toasts.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover and focus; nothing moves.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: A list fading while new data loads.

motion.name: enter
motion.purpose: Dialogs and menus fading and zooming in slightly when opened.

motion.name: hero-crossfade
motion.purpose: The homepage hero's next photo fading in while the one before fades out, across the full width.

motion.name: hero-hold
motion.purpose: How long each hero photo shows; its marker fills over the same time. Paused while the controls are pointed at or focused.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a view, such as Add student or Save changes.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add student</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(0.305 0.1 258); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.305 0.1 258 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside the primary one, such as Export.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A text field with a magnifier, as on the Students list.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search by name or admission no." /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 288px; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 36px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.6); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); }

components.name: Filter Select
components.description: A compact dropdown that names itself inside the box; a set filter gets a darker border and grey fill.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.6); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-filter span { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-filter b { font-weight: 500; } .ds-filter:hover { border-color: oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-filter-set { border-color: oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.3); background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Status Tabs
components.description: A row of labels on a hairline; the open tab is ink and semibold with a Signal Blue underline, counts beside each label.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 0 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(0.922 0 0); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; } .ds-tabs button { position: relative; height: 44px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; background: none; color: oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.6); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs small { margin-left: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-tabs .on { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tabs .on small { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-tabs .on::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.5 0.17 262); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.5 0.17 262); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Register Card
components.description: The one flat card that holds a page's work, with a heading band table inside.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 420px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.7); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table th { height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; text-align: left; background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.4); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.7); color: oklch(0.556 0 0); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.6); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-size: 15px; } .ds-table tr:hover td { background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-roll { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.305 0.1 258); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.979 0.021 166); color: oklch(0.508 0.118 165.6); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: The navy menu; the current page sits on a light tile with a Merit Gold bar at its edge.
components.css: .ds-side { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 232px; padding: 12px; background: oklch(0.285 0.11 263); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; } .ds-side a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px 0 20px; border-radius: 5px; color: oklch(1 0 0); font-size: 14.5px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-side a:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-side .on { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1); font-weight: 600; } .ds-side .on::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: oklch(0.82 0.14 82); } .ds-side a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.14 82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Page Title
components.description: Every page's title: a Signal Blue bar above it and a count badge beside it.
components.css: .ds-title { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; } .ds-title h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-title h1::before { content: ""; display: block; width: 28px; height: 3px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.5 0.17 262); } .ds-count { margin-bottom: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.955 0.018 258); color: oklch(0.305 0.1 258); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Hero Buttons
components.description: The homepage hero's two actions over the photographs: white with the school colour's ink, and a white outline beside it.
components.html: Admission info Contact us
components.css: .ds-hero { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; background: oklch(0.285 0.11 263); font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; } .ds-hero a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-hero-primary { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.285 0.11 263); } .ds-hero-primary:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-hero-outline { border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.6); color: oklch(1 0 0); } .ds-hero-outline:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-hero a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.82 0.14 82); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chapter Margin
components.description: A homepage chapter's margin: its number like a printed folio, a short hairline and the title.
components.css: .ds-chapter { max-width: 260px; font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; } .ds-chapter-no { display: block; font-size: 64px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: oklch(0.305 0.1 258); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chapter-rule { display: block; width: 48px; height: 1px; margin: 20px 0 16px; background: oklch(0.922 0 0); } .ds-chapter h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-chapter p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); }

components.name: Notice Row
components.description: One dated line of the homepage's notices: the day large in the margin, the title, its marks and a chevron; hairlines between rows.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 24px; width: 100%; padding: 20px 8px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.7); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.7); background: oklch(1 0 0); text-align: left; font-family: "Times New Roman", Tinos, Times, serif; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-notice:hover, .ds-notice:focus-visible { background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.5); outline: none; } .ds-notice-date { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-right: 20px; border-right: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.7); } .ds-notice-date b { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.305 0.1 258); } .ds-notice-date small { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-notice-main strong { display: block; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.35; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-notice:hover strong { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-notice-meta { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-notice-meta em { font-style: normal; padding: 1px 8px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.952 0.022 262); color: oklch(0.5 0.17 262); }

narrative.overview:
SNCMT looks like the register book that sits on every school office desk: ruled, orderly, kept in navy ink, with a gold mark on the page you are working on. Office staff spend whole days in it, so it stays calm and readable rather than exciting. Its authority comes from order: rows that line up, numbers that sit in columns, labels that never move. Its warmth comes from the serif type, the gold, and plain friendly words, not from decoration.

The system is flat. Surfaces are white paper on a cool grey desk, separated by hairlines and light grey bands rather than shadows. Colour is rare and always means something: Register Navy carries structure and the main action, Merit Gold marks where you are, Signal Blue points at the current section, and status colours say present, absent, paid or suspended. Everything else is ink on paper.

Density follows the work. Tables and forms are compact enough to show a full class on one screen, but every row has room to breathe and every control reads as clickable for staff who are not technical. Bangla and English share every screen, so layouts allow for longer Bangla words and Bangla digits.

Each school's public homepage is the same register turned outward: the school's prospectus. It opens on the school's own photographs, shown whole and fading one into the next beside its name, then reads as numbered chapters on ruled paper (about, admission, notices, gallery, contact). It is quieter than a marketing page: real photographs supply the warmth, and the rest is order, serif type and hairlines in the school's own colour.
keyCharacteristics: Navy sidebar, white paper, cool grey desk; gold marks the current place.
Flat at rest: hairlines and grey bands instead of shadows.
Serif type everywhere, sized a step larger in Bangla than in English.
Small, consistent corners (4px for controls, 8px for cards).
Colour only where it carries meaning.
The public homepage is a prospectus: the school's photographs whole, then numbered chapters on ruled paper.

rules.name: The Gold Marks the Place Rule
rules.body: Merit Gold appears only to say "you are here" or to highlight on navy. Never use it for buttons, text on white, or decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: One accent per screen: Signal Blue (or the school's chosen accent) for the title bar, the open tab and links. A second decorative colour is never added.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Any colour beyond navy, gold, blue and neutrals must carry a status. If it doesn't mean something, it is grey.

rules.name: The Bangla Is Not a Translation Rule
rules.body: Every text size, line length and label must work in Bangla first; English is set a step smaller to match its visual weight.

rules.name: The Numbers in Columns Rule
rules.body: Rolls, counts, amounts and dates use tabular figures so they line up down a column.

rules.name: The Counted Chapters Rule
rules.body: Homepage chapters are numbered in page order, counting only the chapters the school has filled in, so they always run 01, 02, 03 in the page's digits. The menu, the numbers and the footer follow the same list.

rules.name: The Hairline, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px hairline or a grey band. If you reach for a drop shadow on something that does not float, use a border instead.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Cards and buttons do not rise, glow or scale on hover. Hover changes a background or a border, nothing more.

rules.name: The Fill or Whole Rule
rules.body: A school's photograph fills the hero stage only while that loses at most 40% of it. A photo that would lose more (a tall poster on a desktop, a landscape photo on a phone) is shown whole, over a blurred, dimmed copy of itself filling the stage, never cut down to a fragment. The one gradient in the system is the hero's shade: the school colour darkened, rising from the bottom (and from the left from 1024px) so the white words read on any photo. Nowhere else.

dos: **Do** separate surfaces with 1px hairlines at 60 to 70% and light grey bands, never shadows at rest.
**Do** keep one solid Register Navy Ink button per view for the main action; everything else is outlined or ghost.
**Do** use Merit Gold only to mark the current place or to highlight on navy.
**Do** use tabular figures for rolls, counts, amounts and dates.
**Do** size type for Bangla first, with English one step smaller.
**Do** keep corners small and consistent: 4px controls, 8px cards, full circles only for avatars, pills and badges.
**Do** open every school's homepage on its own photographs, shown whole beside the words on the school colour, and give the slideshow a pause button.
**Do** lay homepage content out as numbered chapters with their titles in the margin, ruled with hairlines rather than boxed in cards.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, hover lifts, glows or scaling to cards and buttons.
**Don't** use gradients (the hero's shade is the one exception), gradient text or decorative colour washes, and don't cut a school's photograph down to a fragment: past 40% lost, show it whole.
**Don't** decorate the homepage with glow blobs, dot patterns, tilted colour blocks or pinging badges, and don't put a small label (a kicker) above a heading.
**Don't** use a second accent colour or any hue that does not carry a status.
**Don't** depend on the sidebar being navy outside the sidebar; schools choose their own sidebar colour.
**Don't** put Merit Gold text on white or use gold for buttons.
